payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of how hateful tweets aimed at women are detected and classified using the ParityBOT system, which employs the Perspective API's TOXICITY feature for classification.

claims.text: Hateful tweets aimed at women are detected and classified using the Perspective API's TOXICITY probability feature, which is predictive for identifying such tweets.
ParityBOT collects tweets directed at women candidates and analyzes them in real-time to classify them as hateful or not.
The classification system of ParityBOT was validated on public online harassment datasets, ensuring its effectiveness in identifying abusive content.
